sources.snippet: EpochDB is a high-performance, state-aware memory engine designed for lossless, tiered storage, atomic state management, and multi-hop relational reasoning. It is built specifically for AI agents that require perfect historical recall, long-term state persistence, and deterministic fact corrections.

sources.snippet: Traditional AI memory systems compress conversations through destructive summarization. EpochDB bypasses this constraint by storing "Unified Memory Atoms"—the raw text intrinsically paired with dense embeddings.
